name: io.github.atlasent-systems-inc/mcp-server
title: AtlaSent MCP Server
description: Enforce authorize-before-execute for any MCP-compatible AI agent. Wraps AtlaSent's signed-permit evaluation and verify-permit API as MCP tools — the only L4 Execution Assurance layer for AI agents.

environmentVariables.name: ATLASENT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: AtlaSent API key (from your AtlaSent dashboard). Leave blank to run in local mode.

environmentVariables.name: ATLASENT_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: AtlaSent API base URL. Defaults to the hosted SaaS endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: ATLASENT_MODE
environmentVariables.description: remote (default when API key + base URL set) or local (in-process rules engine, no API calls)
